currency.basis: The flat one-color #003087 outline monogram is PayPal's current monogram variant of the 2024-2025 brand refresh; observed live on official PayPal properties on 2026-10-03. The accepted icon is the older filled two-tone monogram variant in a circle with non-official #183686 fill.

identity.basis: The double-P monogram is PayPal's own mark, served from PayPal's official CDN (paypalobjects.com) and consistent with the official site's declared logo assets.

assessment.independenceRationale: Both observations come from PayPal's own properties (paypal.com homepage and developer.paypal.com) plus the official CDN asset itself; they are one official provenance group, which is sufficient because identity and currency of a current operating brand rest on official use.
uncertainties: No official press/brand-kit bundle page was located; the monogram URL was verified by successful live fetch from the official CDN.
A two-tone filled monogram variant, if still used officially anywhere, was not located; the located official monogram is the flat outline style.

variant.basis: Standalone double-P monogram without accompanying text; suitable as a standalone catalog mark. The wordmark variant (black 'PayPal' text) was rejected for catalog use because of the accompanying name.

candidate.detailsJudgement: Outline monogram paths, single #003087 fill and transparency identical between the source and final in source/final comparison on both themes; no detail loss.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Standalone mark on transparency, source proportions preserved, no backing added, no transform beyond none; complete fit at 240px with even margins, recognizable at 32px on both themes. Disclosed limitation: the flat dark-blue #003087 mark has reduced contrast on the dark theme background, inherent to the official one-color variant; no recoloring is permitted.
candidate.rationale: Documented rebrand update: the accepted icon is the superseded filled two-tone monogram in a dark circle with non-official #183686 fill; PayPal's current brand uses this flat one-color #003087 outline monogram, retrieved from the official CDN.
candidate.role: catalog standalone brand mark on transparency
transforms: No geometry transformation: official monogram SVG used as fetched (viewBox 0 0 48 48, flat #003087).

SVGO 4.1.0 with frozen worktree svgo.config.mjs (sha256 f2a406e0...), multipass: 2443 -> 2381 bytes; optimized version selected (visually identical to working version at 240px on both themes, confirmed by model image comparison of rsvg-convert renders).
candidate.variant: official flat one-color outline double-P monogram (2024-2025 brand refresh)
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: Accepted icon is a filled two-tone white/blue monogram in a dark circle; candidate is the current flat outline monogram without backing — visibly different variant and presentation.

proposals.reason: Accepted icon (sha256 dc7a58d5...) is the superseded 2014-era two-tone filled PP monogram in a dark-blue circle using non-official fill #183686. PayPal's current brand (2024-2025 refresh) uses a flat one-color #003087 outline double-P monogram; an official original-vector monogram was retrieved from the official PayPal CDN and is proposed as a candidate replacement.

Closing without merging following review.

**Rejection category:** `technical`
**Reviewed head:** `4906983b59a77b5d84d550fe431c20225c727b7d`

**Reason:** The thin dark-blue outline is poorly visible on a dark background. The official origin of the monochrome SVG is not disputed; the defect is its usability as a catalog icon in the required presentation.

**Required follow-up for the maintenance agent:** Choose another supported original representation with adequate visibility on both backgrounds, and verify it at 24 and 32 px. Do not arbitrarily recolor the mark or thicken its strokes. If no suitable original representation can be established, do not make this replacement.

This decision is based on `bank-icons-audit-2026-10-06.md`, `bank-icons-review-2026-10-05.pdf`, and `bank-icons-crosscheck-2026-10-05.pdf`, with the audit corrections taking precedence over unsupported cross-review claims.

[Supporting evidence](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/ddfcce4ee7178a1bcf87720876b3ad233fa7e1e0/review-materials/15692/comparison-dark.png?raw=true)

This rejection applies to this candidate, not permanently to the bank. A fresh proposal must resolve the specific defect above.

```json
{
  "countryCode": null,

```

Frozen base commit: `fe29fbc1291b8842ed201261408a3bc690875b55`. Checked: `2026-10-03T22:52:02.308605Z`.

### Exact versions and source

- Current/base SVG: [base.svg](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/ddfcce4ee7178a1bcf87720876b3ad233fa7e1e0/review-materials/15692/base.svg) — SHA-256 `dc7a58d5a61511bdbe17e4b2f30c4b14e4eb841c1a03b965a9ba16a7feaeea96`.

Official developer icon listing hosts SVGs on paypalobjects.com; PayPal's own monogram is not listed there, but confirms paypalobjects.com as PayPal's official SVG asset host. (independence group: official-paypal-properties).

The accepted icon is the older filled two-tone monogram variant in a circle with non-official #183686 fill..

Role: catalog standalone brand mark on transparency; variant: official flat one-color outline double-P monogram \(2024-2025 brand refresh\).
Visible difference: Accepted icon is a filled two-tone white/blue monogram in a dark circle; candidate is the current flat outline monogram without backing — visibly different variant and presentation..
Details: Outline monogram paths, single #003087 fill and transparency identical between the source and final in source/final comparison on both themes; no detail loss.. Proportions: Standalone mark on transparency, source proportions preserved, no backing added, no transform beyond none; complete fit at 240px with even margins, recognizable at 32px on both themes. Disclosed limitation: the flat dark-blue #003087 mark has reduced contrast on the dark theme background, inherent to the official one-color variant; no recoloring is permitted..

Source-to-final transformations:
- No geometry transformation: official monogram SVG used as fetched \(viewBox 0 0 48 48, flat #003087\).
- SVGO 4.1.0 with frozen worktree svgo.config.mjs \(sha256 f2a406e0...\), multipass: 2443 -\> 2381 bytes; optimized version selected \(visually identical to working version at 240px on both themes, confirmed by model image comparison of rsvg-convert renders\).

![Before and after — light background](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/ddfcce4ee7178a1bcf87720876b3ad233fa7e1e0/review-materials/15692/comparison-light.png?raw=true)

![Before and after — dark background](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/ddfcce4ee7178a1bcf87720876b3ad233fa7e1e0/review-materials/15692/comparison-dark.png?raw=true)

### Render checks and limits

Desktop renderer recorded: `offscreen CPU Skia/painterResource` at `2026-10-03T22:49:11.940184825Z`. Source/final: Source raster and final render match exactly on both themes \(outline geometry, color, transparency\); no invented colors or geometry.; base/final and rendering: Base \(filled two-tone monogram in #183686 circle\) versus final \(flat outline monogram\) inspected on both 240px theme frames: visible update to the current brand variant; final legible at 240px and 32px, with reduced but acceptable dark-theme contrast inherent to the official color.

- android-compose: not-tested (available: false) — No Android emulator, system image or connected device installed \(SDK has cmdline-tools, platform android-37.0, build-tools 36.0.0 only\); installation outside run scope. Risk: plain single-fill paths expected to convert, but no device render observed..
- android-native: not-tested (available: false) — Same missing emulator/system-image prerequisites..
- ios-compose: not-tested (available: false) — No iOS toolchain on this Linux host..
- ios-native: not-tested (available: false) — No iOS toolchain on this Linux host..

Desktop observation is for the generated XML through Compose Desktop `painterResource`, not a claim of successful Android/iOS or native-widget rendering. Unavailable targets remain untested; reviewer visual approval and merge remain separate decisions.
